description: Retrieval golden set. expected_sections are exact section_path values from data/processed/sections.json; a question is a hit when any of them appears in the top-k. Unanswerable questions are priced/quotas/how-to requests the whitepaper does not cover; they are excluded from ranking metrics and reported separately.
